mapper.sql: select v.record_id, v.user_id, v.dept_id, v.event_type, v.location, v.student_name, v.detail, v.ai_reply, v.raw_text, v.audio_path, v.record_date, v.deleted_at, v.create_by, v.create_time, v.update_by, v.update_time, u.nick_name as recorder_name from visit_record v left join sys_user u on v.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into visit_record( user_id, dept_id, event_type, location, student_name, detail, ai_reply, raw_text, audio_path, record_date, create_by, create_time ) values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{eventType}, #{location}, #{studentName}, #{detail}, #{aiReply}, #{rawText}, #{audioPath}, #{recordDate}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update visit_record set deleted_at = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
update visit_record set deleted_at = null where record_id = #{recordId}
